segments.name: Digital advertising
segments.description: Runs an independent omni-channel sell-side platform where publishers monetize CTV, video and other digital inventory and buyers purchase it programmatically at scale.
segments.evidence: Management has determined that the Company operates as one operating segment and one reportable segment.

revenueModel.text: Publishers selling digital advertising inventory and the buyers of it pay the company, which keeps a percentage of the ad spend running through its platform or fixed fees.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company keeps a percentage of that advertising spend as a fee, and remits the remainder to the seller.
